facts.statement: The genus Holbotia was described by Zelenkov and Averianov in 2016.
The genus name Holbotia refers to the location where the holotype fossil was discovered.
facts.quote: The generic name Holbotia is in reference to the locality at which the holotype was found.

facts.statement: The species name ponomarenkoi honors Alexander G. Ponomarenko, the paleoentomologist who discovered the type specimen.
facts.quote: The specific epithet of the type and only species, Holbotia ponomarenkoi, honours the palaeoentomologist Alexander G. Ponomarenko, the discoverer of the type specimen.

facts.statement: Holbotia is an extinct genus containing only one species and belongs to the bird group Enantiornithes.
facts.quote: Holbotia is an extinct monotypic genus of enantiornithean bird

facts.statement: Holbotia lived in Mongolia during the Early Cretaceous epoch.
facts.quote: Holbotia is an extinct monotypic genus of enantiornithean bird that lived in Mongolia during the Early Cretaceous epoch.

facts.statement: Holbotia lived between 132.6 and 121.4 million years ago during the Hauterivian to Barremian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Hauterivian to Barremian (132.6 to 121.4 million years ago)

facts.statement: Holbotia is classified within the parent group Enantiornithes.
Holbotia is classified under the class Reptilia.
